threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep looking for the 30 bus stop but don’t realize it’s just a light on the corner; locals know it doesn't follow 'normal' routes.
Caught a bloke on the 37 last night singing opera to himself. Didn't even flinch when the driver glanced back. Classic Peckham moment.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Hearing a spontaneous street concert in the courtyard while the smell of döner wafts in from across the street—only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find hidden courtyard bars where the drink menu changes daily based on what the bartender feels like mixing. Absolute gems!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: If they know the difference between a raspa and a snow cone, they're a local. Tourists just say 'ice treat' and look lost.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 31 Balboa, sipping sparkling water. Only in SF do folks dress for a black-tie event and take the bus afterwards.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just a loud fiesta. They miss the quiet mornings where locals sip café con leche and chat about last night’s Barça game.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still walk into cafés expecting to find a table without a reservation during peak hours. Sweet naivety.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the 38 bus will take you anywhere on time. Locals know better than to trust the clock around here.
Last night on the 35, a guy sang every word of ‘Wonderwall’ like he was in the Royal Albert Hall. A proper audience joined in halfway.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a guy in full dirndl confidently ordering a kebab at 2 AM. Only in Neukölln do cultures blend like that.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you’ll find random techno raves in the U-Bahn tunnels. Just a regular Saturday night, complete with neon lights and an underground vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows that the smells wafting from the taquerias change with the weather, spicy one day, sweet the next.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy at the Civic Center Muni stop with a cat on a leash. Turns out it was the cat that was leading him—total role reversal.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Many tourists think Gràcia's plazas are just for selfies, but locals use them for real conversations and late-night gatherings. They miss the vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot a recent arrival by their tendency to walk into the wrong bar, ordering a 'café con leche' in the evening like it’s normal.
